nodes.name: Evolution Webhook
nodes.notes:
Receives all Evolution API webhook events.
Configure Evolution instance webhook URL to: https://your-n8n-domain/webhook/evolution-webhook
Set events: MESSAGES_UPSERT

parameters.query:
-- Dedup + Classify + Link + Night activation in one round-trip.
-- C3 fix: classify FIRST, then insert message with correct conversation_id.
-- C4 fix: auto-activate night_queued conversations for AI handling.
WITH classification AS (
  SELECT * FROM classify_sender($4)
),
activate_night AS (
  UPDATE conversations
  SET mode = 'ai'
  WHERE conversation_id = (SELECT conversation_id FROM classification)
    AND mode = 'night_queued'
),
dedup AS (
  INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, body, msg_external_id, metadata)
  VALUES ((SELECT conversation_id FROM classification), 'inbound', 'lead', $1, $2, $3::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (msg_external_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING message_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT message_id FROM dedup) AS new_message_id,
  c.is_agent,
  c.agent_id,
  c.agent_name,
  c.conversation_id,
  CASE WHEN c.conv_mode = 'night_queued' THEN 'ai' ELSE c.conv_mode END AS conv_mode,
  c.assigned_agent_id,
  c.current_property,
  c.assigned_agent_phone
FROM classification c;
